instruction: Cinematic full shot of an indoor gym filled with light smoke. On the left, the shirtless man with short dark hair (R1) stands in profile wearing black shorts and black boxing gloves, holding a defensive stance. On the right, the shirtless bearded man with a shoulder tattoo (R3) stands wearing black shorts over colorful patterned tights and boxing gloves, facing left in an active boxing stance. The two men face each other on a white gym mat, sparring. A bright central spotlight shines through the haze, creating a misty, atmospheric mood.
